disclaimer: Estimates only, not certified carbon savings.

grid_electricity.label: Pakistan grid average electricity

source.name: Ember, Yearly Electricity Data, as published through Our World in Data
datasets: Our World in Data: carbon intensity of electricity

notes: Average grid factor: generation-weighted national mix, not a marginal factor.
Data year is 2025; the app must always display the data year and must not imply the factor is live.

suzuki_alto_660.label: Suzuki Alto 660cc (base comparison)
suzuki_alto_660.rationale: Pakistan's best-selling car: 29% of PAMA-reported sales in 2025, its sixth straight year at number one. City fuel average of 18 km/L as listed by PakWheels.

toyota_corolla_12.label: Toyota Corolla 1.3-1.6L (sensitivity case)
toyota_corolla_12.rationale: Sensitivity case at about 12 km/L. Based on a user-reported range of 10-12 km/L plus a third-party benchmark.

petrol.label: Petrol combustion
petrol.derivation: 8887 g CO2 per US gallon of gasoline / 3.785 L per gallon = 2.348 kg/L, rounded to 2.35
sources: US EPA: 8,887 g CO2 per gallon of gasoline
UK DEFRA 2023 factor of 2.345 kgCO2e/L (via Climatiq listing), which matches

well_to_tank.note: Upstream emissions (extraction, refining, transport) are not included. Roughly a fifth higher is an unsourced estimate, not used in any calculation. Add a sourced well-to-tank factor and set enabled to true to include it.

comparison_basis_warning: Basis mismatch: the petrol factor counts tailpipe combustion only, while the grid factor is lifecycle. The UI and reports must state which basis each figure uses. Avoided-emissions figures are estimates and are not certified carbon savings or carbon credits.
